propositions: fsck must detect and classify tracked deletions of store artifacts, untracked regenerable compaction leftovers, and orphaned temporary event files as distinct dirty-tracker findings in both text and JSON output

doctor --repair must heal a dirty-tree wedge by restoring tracked deletions via git checkout, quarantining regenerable leftovers, and deferring temporary event files for manual triage, all under non-reentrant write-lock discipline
repair must record a backup ref before any file mutations and invoke reconverge in a separate lock window after file-level changes are complete and released
fsck dirty-tracker findings and doctor repair actions must preserve all file bytes (move rather than delete, restore rather than overwrite), leaving unclassified files unchanged
doctor --repair must be idempotent and refuse all mutations if the backup ref cannot be recorded; lock must be held during file mutations and released before reconverge invocation
